test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Armature and Coil Winder) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In large AC motors, multi-spindle winding machines are used to ___________.

options.text: Insertion of Insulating Material into Stator Slots
Measurement of the resistance of each coil winding
Application of coil cooling agent throughout the entire welding process.
Winding multiple coils simultaneously and increasing production efficiency.

solution:
The correct answer is __Winding multiple coils simultaneously and increasing production efficiency****.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Multi-spindle winding machines__ are specifically designed for winding coils efficiently.
 
• They help in simultaneously winding multiple coils, reducing manual effort and increasing productivity.
 
• These machines ensure consistent quality and precise winding across all coils.
 
• The use of multi-spindle winding machines is crucial in large-scale manufacturing of AC motors.
 
• They save time and improve overall production efficiency.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Insertion of Insulating Material:**
 
 
• This involves placing insulation inside stator slots to prevent electrical short circuits.
 
• It is typically done before winding the coils.
 
 
 
• **Measurement of Coil Resistance:**
 
 
• This step ensures uniformity and quality of the coils.
 
• Resistance measurement is a testing process conducted after coil winding.
 
 
 
• **Application of Cooling Agent:**
 
 
• Cooling agents are used to maintain coil temperature during manufacturing processes.
 
• This step is essential for heat dissipation and maintaining machine efficiency.
